notes.title: Patch Update
notes.content: After analyzing gameplays from some streamers, I got feedback and changed details to improve the players experience.. some tweaked details are the tips to complete the puzzles..

notes.title: Patch Notes
notes.content:
Fixed bug that disabled character movement after death.
Environment changes on the first map (cult).
Disabled the ability to enter the lagoon (first map).
Changing the entity's way of acting in the second map (Chase).
Increased the size of character subtitles.

notes.title: Notes
notes.content: Adjusted for interactions with letters if the character loses movement at the end of interaction, pressing esc twice returns movement.
